About

I’m a bilingual (English/Spanish) graphic designer with over 10 years of experience creating logos, flyers, menus, print materials, web design, and digital artwork for nightlife, restaurant, and business clients.

I work in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign, with experience in Dreamweaver, Maya, and Blender3D, and a strong foundation in typography and color theory.

Since 2022, I’ve also supported RE/MAX 1st Advantage – The Robert Dekanski Team with data entry and CRM management, bringing the same attention to detail to both creative and administrative work.
